text:
noah: hey all :wave: I'm on my first day and stuck on a few setup things. Okta SSO keeps failing with 'Device trust: Managed Apple ID mismatch' when I try to sign in. Also the 'Redwood Onboarding' drive folder doesn't appear in my Drive, and 1Password invite says no seats available. who do I ping?

it-support: hey @noah sorry about that — can you confirm whether you used a personal Apple ID on the Mac before we enrolled it?
noah: i did use my personal Apple ID initially, yes. I just switched to the company-managed one in Settings -> Apple ID but Okta still rejects it.
ava: managed Apple IDs can take a few minutes to propagate. If you signed out of your personal ID and signed into the managed one, try restarting and then hitting the SSO flow again.
noah: restarted, still same error: "Device trust: Managed Apple ID mismatch". Any logs I can paste?
samir: can you paste the output of `profiles status -type enrollment` and `dsconfigad -show`? (no need to paste sensitive tokens, just presence/absence lines).
noah: posted outputs: ```profiles status -type enrollment
  - mdm: enrolled
  - userApproved: false
dsconfigad -show
  NoActiveDirectoryServer: true```
it-support: ah — userApproved: false means MDM enrollment isn't confirmed for the user. Looks like the device was enrolled but the AppleID wasn't associated properly with the MDM user record. We'll re-run the enrollment flow.
it-bot: Ticket #ONB-2142 created for device-trust; assignee: it-support. ETA 2 business hours.
lina: looping in People Ops to confirm your account provisioning — @lina here, can you DM me your preferred employee email (the one on your offer)? I'll check if the Okta profile has the managedAppleId field.
noah: sent DM with email. thanks.
ava: while we wait for IT, for the Drive issue try this quick workaround: open drive.google.com/drive/shared-with-me and search "Redwood Onboarding"; sometimes the initial share takes longer and doesn't auto-add to My Drive. If you find it, hit Add shortcut to Drive.
noah: found it in Shared with me! added shortcut, thanks. Drive access sorted. :thumbsup:
samir: re: 1Password seat — sometimes seats aren't auto-assigned until Okta provisioning completes. @lina once you're OK that Okta profile is good, I can trigger provisioning to 1Password from the admin console.
lina: confirming now — yep, managedAppleId blank earlier, updated to match your offer email. please try SSO again after IT finishes the re-enroll.
it-support: re-enrollment done, set userApproved to true. Try signing in now.
noah: Okta login succeeded! device trust passed. 1Password invite also arrived. all green. thank you everyone :tada:
ava: welcome aboard @noah! ping this thread if anything else pops up during first-week setup.
noah: thank you — much appreciated.
